---
title: "Contact me"
---

<form id="fs-frm" name="simple-contact-form" accept-charset="utf-8" action="https://formspree.io/f/mnqyaejw" method="post">
  <fieldset id="fs-frm-inputs">
    <label class="form-label" for="email-address">Your email</label>
    <input class="form-control" type="email" name="_replyto" id="email-address" required="">
    <label class="form-label" for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" rows="5" name="message" id="message" required=""></textarea>
    <input type="hidden" name="_subject" id="email-subject" value="Contact Form Submission">
  </fieldset>
  <input class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" value="Send">
</form>
